correctness.rationale: Writing a_kj=-B_kj≥0, b_j=B_jj>0, the nonnegative component equations give M²/2≤C(r+M) for M=max_{j != i} z_j, hence M=O(1+sqrt r). Dominant ith equation yields r=√(2t)−b_i+O(t^(−1/4)), while each other j equation ½ z_j²=a_ij r+O(t^1/4) shows z_j/t^1/4→2^3/4 sqrt(a_ij) (including zero case). Summing η>0 gives coefficient; zero row yields exact scalar IG solution by uniqueness, positive coefficient excludes both drift-free IG (bounded difference from leading sqrt) and drifted IG (linear term). Independent 2-type exact triangular solutions for couplings 0,1/2,2 at t=10^4,10^8,10^12 converge to calculated coefficient; finite tests are corroborative only.
